role_reviews.name: Exterior edge dirt bands
role_reviews.target_specific_observation: Current DayOneCastleGrime draws four screen-edge dirt bands while these rooms own the generic grime layer;the pool-only authored-dirt guard does not exempt Playroom/Art. No source retirement.

comparison.contour: Compare every named mark with the irregular painted contours of the same-scene stonework,toy throne,desk,brushes,cloth and approved Roshan/Eagle cutouts. Straight screen-edge bands,regular circles/stock stars and large emoji rims remain visible style gaps.
comparison.material: Source-painted furniture/supplies have local value bands and specific material cues; uniform code washes/rings/glyphs and stock-star tinting do not share those materials. Raster format alone never establishes a painted/zero-flat pass.
comparison.palette: The purple-grey disrepair wash changes room and actor values before cleanup;warm gold hand/halo/green motes can dominate small targets. Preserve source identity colors and each live target cue during repair.
comparison.light: Painted room fixtures carry authored highlights/shadows; flat marks do not have matching material-specific light. No permission to relight the originals; current wash is measured as an existing style/overdraw gap.
comparison.perspective: Room objects share the pictured room projection. Overlay hand/rings/stars are screen-facing;wide-side motifs remain unrelated to physical room depth. Repairs need actual scene orientation rather than isolated-icon approval.
comparison.scale: At1600x720 the1280scene is letterboxed; background motifs remain visible in margins. The hand/desk halos and pop motes are large relative to their targets and can compete with Roshan. Device squint review still absent.
comparison.contact: Real cleanup taps use the production travel/work callback. Files named _contact are merely early12-frame action samples,not independently proved hand contact. Sparse frames do not accept anatomy,motion,tail support or shadows.
comparison.occlusion: Green/gold burst stars overlap Roshan/Eagle in pin-release views;desk halo crosses the room. Foreground furniture occludes portions of working Roshan in Art states;per-target full action visibility is still open.
comparison.readability: Large hand and persistent targets are conspicuous on desktop;actual non-reader/phone and owner evaluation remain open. Preserve transparent generous hit geometry separately from visible illustration.
comparison.action_state: Four current cases pass real pointer hall doors,rescue or7cleanup/desk confirmation,private save/reload and current-source re-entry.
